name: jg-product-design-plugin-codex
description: Product-design skills for demand management, prototype design and editing, review and weekly meeting minutes, UI acceptance, prototype self-check, delivery map updates, and ZenTao SR preparation.

interface.shortDescription: Demand, prototype, review, meetings, acceptance, and delivery maps.
interface.longDescription: The maintained Codex source for the product-design workflow. It supports rough-demand to PRD discussion, security-triggered requirements, HTML prototype generation and local annotation editing, design-review memos, product weekly meeting host scripts and final minutes, browser-based UI acceptance, prototype self-check, prototype-to-PRD backfill, R&D Word requirement specifications, and ZenTao SR preparation. Monthly tracking workbooks can update network-management and centralized-control delivery maps with customer mapping checks and preview publishing. The dedicated Jiguan skill updates delivery progress maps and preserves the online-document link for delivery versions and middleware details.
